utility.question: How much is the Growth plan?

result.reply: The Growth plan is $59/month and includes 2,000 shipments and 5 user seats. Additional shipments cost $0.03 each. With annual billing, you pay for 10 months and get 2 months free.

utility.question: how many shipments do i get on starter

result.reply: The Starter plan includes 300 shipments per month. Additional shipments cost $0.05 each, and unused shipments don’t roll over.

utility.question: What happens if I go over my monthly shipments on the Growth plan?

result.reply: The Growth plan includes 2,000 shipments per month. Each shipment over that limit costs $0.03, billed on your next invoice.

utility.question: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?

result.reply: Yes. With annual billing, you get 2 months free and pay for 10 months.

utility.question: Do my unused shipments carry over to next month?

result.reply: No, unused shipments don't carry over to the next month.

utility.question: Do I need a credit card for the free trial?

result.reply: No, you don’t need a credit card to start the 14-day free trial. If you buy a label during the trial, postage is charged to the payment method you add when buying your first label.

utility.question: How long is the trial and how many labels can I make?

result.reply: The free trial lasts 14 days and includes up to 50 shipments. Postage for labels you buy during the trial is still charged to your payment method.

utility.question: Can you extend my trial by a week? I haven't had time to test it.

result.reply: Sorry, trials can’t be extended. Each trial lasts 14 days and includes up to 50 shipments.

utility.question: I'm on a monthly plan. If I cancel halfway through the month do I get the rest refunded?

result.reply: No. Monthly plans don’t receive refunds or prorated credits for the remaining days. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of your current billing period.

utility.question: I paid for a year 3 weeks ago and want to cancel. Can I get money back?

result.reply: A human agent will follow up about canceling your annual plan and whether a refund is available.

utility.question: How long do I have to void a USPS label?

result.reply: You can void a USPS label within 28 days of purchase from the Shipments page. The postage is returned to your Tidewell balance, and USPS refunds can take up to 21 days to be approved.

utility.question: I voided a label, why isn't the money back on my card?

result.reply: Voided postage is returned to your Tidewell balance, not your card. If it was a USPS label, the refund can take up to 21 days to be approved.

utility.question: Which carriers do you support?

result.reply: Tidewell supports USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL Express, and Canada Post. Canada Post is available only for shipments starting in Canada. Amazon Shipping, OnTrac, and regional couriers are not supported.

utility.question: Can I ship with Amazon Shipping through Tidewell?

result.reply: No, Tidewell does not currently support Amazon Shipping.

utility.question: Can I use my own negotiated USPS rates?

result.reply: No. You can use Tidewell’s discounted USPS rates, but connecting your own carrier account for negotiated rates is only supported for UPS, FedEx, and DHL Express.

utility.question: My labels are printing tiny on my Rollo, what do I do?

result.reply: For your Rollo, check that the printer’s paper size is set to 4x6 inches and scaling is set to 100%, not “fit to page.”

utility.question: If I reprint a label does it charge me again?

result.reply: No. Reprinting a label does not create a new charge. You can reprint it for free from the Shipments page within 30 days of buying it.

utility.question: Can my customers get text message tracking updates on the Starter plan?

result.reply: No. SMS tracking notifications are available on Growth and Scale, not Starter. Growth includes 500 message credits per month, and Scale includes 3,000; each SMS uses one credit.

utility.question: How do I get a tracking page with my own logo?

result.reply: A branded tracking page with your logo and colors is available on the Scale plan only. Your current Growth plan doesn’t include it.

utility.question: How often do orders come in from Shopify?

result.reply: New Shopify orders sync automatically every 15 minutes. To pull them in right away, click “Sync now” on the Orders page.

utility.question: Do you integrate with eBay?

result.reply: No, Tidewell doesn’t support eBay yet.

utility.question: Do I pay for return labels my customers never use?

result.reply: No. Return labels are only charged when the carrier scans them, so unused labels cost nothing.

utility.question: Can I turn on SMS two-factor login?

result.reply: No, Tidewell doesn’t offer SMS-based two-factor authentication. You can turn on 2FA with an authenticator app in Settings > Security.

utility.question: What's the API rate limit on Growth?

result.reply: The Growth plan API rate limit is 120 requests per minute. Requests over that limit receive an HTTP 429 response.

utility.question: If my webhook endpoint is down, do I lose the events?

result.reply: If your endpoint doesn’t return a 2xx response, Tidewell retries the webhook up to 5 times over 24 hours. The documentation doesn’t say what happens to events after those retries are exhausted.

utility.question: How much does shipping protection cost for a $300 package?
